newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 29.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Chinese President Jiang Zemin tells Indian hosts that 'The Five Principles of Peaceful Co-existence' created by China and India have proved to be a far-reaching contribution to humanity.
China to yuan convertible under the current account on December 1.
Premier Li Peng says construction of the Shanghai International Navigation Centre is a major step toward making Shanghai a major international economic and trade hub.
China launches largest integrated circuit development project with foundation-laying in Shanghai's Pudong development zone.
China welcomes South African President Nelson Mandela's "positive" statement on normalising relations with China.
Britain accused of exceeding its authority in Hong Kong by introducing law on subversion before the colony's return to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997.
